item.title: European Yacht Of The Year 2026
item.description: Advancing from the nominees for the European Yacht Of The Year 2026, there has not been such a promising year in yacht building for a long time. Instead of focusing primarily on increasing volume and living space or, worse still, cutting costs in production, most shipyards have now refocused on core values. The six award-winning models in particular epitomize the return to the essentials. - Full report

item.title: Olympics can’t take a joke
item.description: The Olympic motto CITIUS, ALTIUS, FORTIUS – FASTER, HIGHER, STRONGER has inspired and motivated generations of Olympic athletes over the years. item.title: Records fall in RORC Transatlantic Race
item.description: The 2026 RORC Transatlantic Race was a fast edition with new multihull and monohull elapsed records set for the 3000 nm course from the Canary Islands to Antigua. First in was Jason Carroll’s MOD70 Argo (USA), taking Multihull Line Honors on January 16 with crew Chad Corning (skipper), Pete Cumming, Sam Goodchild, Charles Ogletree, Alister Richardson, Brian Thompson.
